title: FAQ's
section: **PAN applications submitted at TIN Facilitation Centres / PAN Centres**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 61  | 72  |   |  ###     **PAN applications submitted Online using physical mode (i.e. Physical documents forwarded to Protean e-Gov.)**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 61  | 72  |   |  ###     **PAN applications submitted Online through paperless modes (e-KYC & e-Sign / e-Sign scanned based / DSC scanned based):**  |   | 1  | e-PAN Card will be dispatched at the email ID mentioned in the PAN application form  | 56  | 66  |    [ How do I obtain a new PAN card without any changes in details? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseFour) (A) PAN applicants can now apply online for Reprint of PAN card (only when there is no change required in data) by clicking [here](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/ReprintEPan.html). This facility is only available for those PAN holders whose latest PAN application was processed through Protean e-Gov and / or e-Filing portal of Income Tax Department. Option for update of PAN details will not be available through this facility. (B) If the communication address of an applicant as per latest records available with Protean e-Gov is an Indian Address, then applicant needs to make an online fee payment of ₹50 (inclusive of taxes) and if it is a foreign address, then payment of ₹959 (inclusive of taxes) has to be made by the applicant. (C) There is no requirement of submitting any application form along with supporting documents for processing this PAN card reprint request. Kindly click on [guidelines](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/GUIDELINES_FOR_REPRINT_OF_PAN_CARD_THROUGH_SEPARATE_ONLINE_LINK.pdf) to know more.  Alternatively, an applicant can apply for a reprinted PAN card through normal online PAN application mode whose details are given below.  (A) While filling this form, applicant should not select any of the check boxes on the left margin of the form. However, the check box for Item no. 7 Address for communication will be selected by default as this address will be updated in the records of ITD.   * [Read Guidelines](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/correction.html)   * [Read Instructions](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructionscorr.html)   * [Documents to be Submitted](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/documents-req.html)   * [Do’s and Don’ts](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/cr-do-donts.html)   * [Apply](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html)   * [Designated centres accepting Online PAN documents New](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/List_of_centres_for_submission_of_online_PANdocuments.xlsx)  [ What should I do if there are any changes or correction in PAN data? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseFive)
